 the verb {#juhoti#} is applied as distinguished from those to which {#yajati#}
 is applied; {#kzaranti sarvA vEdikyo juhotiyajatikriyAH#} <ls>Ms. 2. 84</ls>. (See
 Medhātithi and other commentators; {#sarvajYanArAyaRa#} shortly renders
 {#juhoti#} by {#upavizwahoma#} and {#yajati#} by {#tizWadDoma#}. See <ls>Āśval. 1. 2. 5</ls>
 also); <ab>cf.</ab> also {#juhotirAsecanADikaH syAt#} <ls>MS. 4. 2. 28</ls>. {#yajatirevAsecanADiko#}
